title: Birth in Muskogee and growing up with three sisters
summary: McShann gives his birth date, January 12, 1916, and says he was the only boy among four children, outnumbered by his three older sisters.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: This is an interview with Jay McShann on December the 11th, 1978, for the Smithsonian Institution. Well, Jay, when were you born and where?
I was born in Muskogee, Oklahoma, on January the 12th, 1916.
Yes. Well, and in our family there was four kids and Dad and mother.
Three elder girls and myself. I was the youngest.
Oh, I don't think so because -- well, you know, you take three girls and a mother in a home, there's no chance for -- even being the youngest boy, to get spoiled
because, you know, you can't win.
